pages.text: Place the engine block, then right-click it with each component it asks for. The goggles show $(item)Engine Unfinished$() and the $(item)Next Component$().

$(l)Regular and radial engines$()$(li)1 Crankshaft, 1 Steel Cogwheel, 1 Large Steel Cogwheel$(li)1 Belt Connector, 2 Steel Pipes, 1 Steel Mechanism$(br2)$(l)Turbine engine$()$(li)1 Shaft, 1 Steel Cogwheel, 2 Steel Pipes, 2 Steel Mechanisms

$(item)Every block of a long engine needs its own full set.$() A three-block engine asks for three sets, one after the other; the goggles say which block you are on ($(item)Building engine 2 of 3$()). You can click any block of the row, the parts go where they are needed.
Made a mistake? Right-click with a $(item)Screwdriver$() to take the last part back out. Breaking an engine block also drops every part that was in it.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
